failures.triage_note: wb_listora_pro_license_check is scheduled on WP-Cron (weekly) instead of Action Scheduler. Commit c977ab7 in CLAUDE.md claims the migration was complete, but the running site has 0 pending AS actions for this hook and wp cron event list shows it as a weekly WP-Cron event scheduled 2026-05-27. Root cause: Cron_Scheduler::schedule_recurring() falls back to WP-Cron when action_scheduler_init has not fired at License::init() call time. The pre-migration WP-Cron event is never cleared unless deactivated and reactivated after the migration commit.
failures.expected: wb_listora_pro_license_check scheduled as recurring Action Scheduler action in group wb-listora-pro, visible in wp-admin/tools.php?page=action-scheduler
failures.actual: wp cron event list shows wb_listora_pro_license_check as weekly WP-Cron event scheduled 2026-05-27. Zero pending AS actions for this hook via actionscheduler_actions table query.

block_reason: 1 failure found: S8-001 (wb_listora_pro_license_check on WP-Cron instead of AS — medium severity, does not block feature functionality but violates the c977ab7 migration claim). This is not a release blocker for user-facing features. A deactivate+reactivate cycle on a fresh install would schedule it correctly. Recommend: fix Cron_Scheduler to actively migrate at runtime when action_scheduler_init fires, or ensure activation hook clears WP-Cron and schedules AS. Release can ship with this as a known P2 issue with a follow-up fix in 1.0.6.
